name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: The pages of a long list, as a row of links.
use: A list or a table split over numbered pages. The links are quiet square buttons; the current page has aria-current="page" and stays sunk, which the button stylesheet draws. When the number of pages is unknown, two labelled buttons, Previous and Next, are enough and need no pagination class.

instead.when: The views have names instead of numbers
The pages are the steps of one task, done in order
The links are the parent pages of the current one

classes.name: pagination
classes.description: The row of page links, on an ol inside a nav with aria-label. Figures are tabular, so the row keeps its width from page to page

classes.name: pagination-gap
classes.description: An ellipsis where pages are left out. It is not a control: hide it with aria-hidden="true"

example:
1. 1
  2. 2
  3. 3
  4. …
  5. 24
